title: 011 - Long Word Filter
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print only the words with length 5 or more as planet,cloud and prints exactly `planet,cloud`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function longWordFilter(array $values): int
{
    return count(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value >= 0));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function longWordFilter(array $values): int
{
    return count(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value > 0));
}
hint: The condition should keep long words, not short ones.
explanation: The comparison is reversed. Keeping words whose length is at least 5 fixes the output.
